implementationSlices.name: Cross-resource attack proof and local evidence

apiKey.exception: Exact secret authentication is a platform lookup that discovers the owning Store; management operations are Store-scoped and ownership is immutable.

sharedServices: Cache keys and automatic tags are Store-prefixed.
File keys are restricted to stores/<store-id>/.
Event metadata carries Store provenance and subscribers restore it.
Index filters, synchronization, pagination, stale cleanup, and reset are Store-partitioned.
Notification idempotency and delivery records are Store-scoped.

attackMatrix.proof: shared operation without Store context is rejected
dedicated operation with a foreign Store context is rejected
foreign Store identifiers cannot be retrieved
list and count queries are Store-filtered in SQL
created records receive the active Store owner
Store owner updates are rejected
cross-Store parent-child relationships are rejected
request-role RLS hides foreign Promotion data
request-role RLS hides foreign Customer data
request-role RLS hides foreign Cart data
request-role RLS hides foreign Payment data
request-role RLS hides foreign Order roots and children
request-role RLS hides foreign Sales Channels
request-role RLS hides foreign Notifications
API key management is scoped while secret authentication resolves ownership
cross-module links validate every certified endpoint owner
cache keys and computed tags cannot collide across Stores
foreign Store file keys are rejected
events reject missing or conflicting Store provenance
event subscribers execute inside the event Store context
Index filtering occurs before pagination
Index reset deletes only the active Store partition
notification idempotency cannot collide across Stores
all migrations are additive and retain explicit down paths

requiresBeforeActivation: application admission of the exact digest
